⏺ Prefix, then percent: the window splits in two,
  a thin line drawn straight down the glass.
  On the left, the logs keep scrolling through;
  on the right, a cursor waits for tests to pass.
  Prefix, then a quote: a pane below,
  where htop breathes in bars of green and red.
  I hop between them, arrow keys in tow,
  three rooms of thought inside a single head.
  Detach, then close the lid and drive away;
  the server hums, the jobs keep running on.
  Next morning, tmux a, and there they stay,
  just as I left them, nothing lost or gone.
